name: flag intent, then yield by a shared turn variable
mechanism: each of two processes sets a flag that it wants in and sets the turn to the other; it enters only when the other's flag is down or the turn is its own, so both cannot be inside and neither waits forever

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Peterson's algorithm' in section Operating systems algorithms / Process synchronization:
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Lamport's Bakery algorithm':

fails_when: reordered memory breaks it; two processes only (the bakery form generalises with tickets)
